quotes.text: This is exactly what I needed, it does the one thing I came for.
It's got a hundred features and not the one I actually need.
That was easy, three taps and done.
I had to learn how it wanted me to do it, it's not obvious at all.
It doesn't look like a real bank, it looks like a cheap template.
It's gorgeous, I love how it feels to use.
It just leaves me cold, there's nothing to it.
I can always see where I am, the menu makes sense.
I searched for 'king size' and got nothing, then just 'king' and got everything.
Oh, there's a whole section for that? I had no idea it was there.
It says 'archive' but it means delete, I'd never have called it that.
My screen reader just says 'button', 'button', 'button', I've no idea which is which.
I can't read that grey text on white, I need it bigger.
I wouldn't put my card details in here, it feels dodgy.
That's not what the other page said, one of them is out of date.
There's no way to find out who actually runs this or how to contact anyone.
I'm really pleased with that, it was worth the money.
I'd switch from what I use now, and I'd tell my friends.
I still don't know if I'm eligible, so I gave up before I could apply.
I got my prescription sorted, which is all I wanted from it.
It's so small on my phone in the sun, I can't see anything.
The reviews all said it was good so I went for it.
